contracts: TreasureRoom.EnterInternal invokes BeginRelicPicking before the chest is opened; a shared rarity draw and shared grab-bag pull occur at preparation, even if the player later skips
Prepared relic identity is hidden until OpenChest; source actor observations exclude the pending offer
OpenChest immediately grants one Rewards.NextInt(42,53) gold command, with Poverty truncation after the roll; it is not a skippable GoldReward
First-ever treasure room with NumberOfRuns0 forces Gorget, removes it from the shared bag and still consumes the rarity draw
Silver Crucible counts room entries and suppresses both relic generation and normal gold/Spoils payout on its first entered treasure room
OneOffSynchronizer completes every SpoilsMap copy after base chest gold, with one600gold command and card removal per copy
SpoilsMap.AfterCreated stores zero-based target act1 (engine act2), rather than always targeting the next act
OPEN_CHEST is appended to the action enum; MT fixture chest behavior remains unchanged
